description_expanded:
A Florida beach rental should provide a sense of escape. This Bermudian courtyard home has 4 bedrooms, a bunk room and 4.5 bathrooms. Designed to captivate, this home pulls you into its expansive courtyard through an entry loggia. Once there, you are rewarded with a large saltwater dipping pool, grill area, surround sound, and lush landscaping. A 1st floor guest primary bedroom opens onto the courtyard, while upstairs there are 3 additional bedrooms— including a primary suite with fireplace. A second floor gallery leads to a gracious 2nd floor terrace that features a summer kitchen and firepit, perfect for entertaining. Located just steps to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, Town Center, ZUMA Wellness Center, and the Nature Preserve, across from Arboleda Park, featuring an alley of live oaks and the Leda sculpture. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, the Silva Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Primary Bedroom

1 King

Guest Bedroom #1

1 King

Guest Bedroom #2

1 King

Guest Bedroom #3

1 King

Bunk Area

1 Twin/Twin Bunk
